'''The Tyrant''' was a [[Sith (species)/Legends|pureblood Sith]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] but was defeated and imprisoned on [[The Tomb]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]; at the start of the [[Galactic War]] he was freed by the [[Invasion of Belsavis|fighting]] and carved a path of destruction through the prison until a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] individual defeated him.
